level1.prompt: Jordan with a crush or a partner is…

options.label: We
options.t: Clingy mode: wants to see them daily and share every detail.

options.label: Me
options.t: Solo mode: loves hard, still guards solo nights and bestie nights.

level1.prompt: You show Jordan the angry text you're about to send. Bad idea. Jordan…

options.label: Soft
options.t: "I get why you're mad." Holds you first, talks you down later.

level1.prompt: Picture Jordan's future home on a big holiday. It's…

options.label: Classic
options.t: The classic: rituals, the family table, parents at ease.

options.label: Own
options.t: A remix: his own rituals, his own rules, no template.

level1.prompt: Jordan gets a surprise bonus. By Friday…

options.label: Venture
options.t: A flight is booked. Life is short.

level1.prompt: Talking plans and life progress, Jordan is…

options.label: Push
options.t: Ambitious: wants real wins and a direction, soon.

options.label: Easy
options.t: Unbothered: who gets promoted or married when is not his business.

level1.prompt: Lines, house rules, what's fair: Jordan is…

options.label: Rules
options.t: Rulebook: the same rules for everyone is the only fair way.

options.label: Context
options.t: Case by case: rules are fixed, people aren't.

cards.prompt: Jordan and an old close friend haven't texted in four months. What does Jordan do?
cards.a: Sends a random pic, no hello, like they never stopped.
cards.b: Waits. The last text was Jordan's.
cards.ownerSaid: Send a random pic, no hello. Like we never stopped.

cards.prompt: Jordan finds $200 in an old jacket. Where does it go?
cards.ownerSaid: Straight into savings. Future me says thanks.

cards.prompt: Last time a friend of Jordan's was clearly in the wrong with someone, he...
cards.a: Told the friend straight that it was wrong.
cards.b: Took the friend for bubble tea first, raised it later.
cards.ownerSaid: Told them straight it was wrong. Left on read for two days.

cards.prompt: On a normal week with a partner or closest friend, Jordan would rather...
cards.a: Share every free evening and narrate the whole day.
cards.b: Keep some nights solo, no explaining needed.
cards.ownerSaid: Some nights I'm offline, and they know not to ask. + I have a hobby they've never tried and never will.

cards.prompt: The crew is getting ready to go out, ride in 10 minutes. Jordan is...
cards.a: Ready in six minutes, hoodie on
cards.b: Doing a full fit check in every mirror
cards.ownerSaid: Ready in six minutes. Hoodie, keys, done.

cards.prompt: Jordan's sibling keeps needing a rescue, and the parents say 'help, you're family.' Jordan is the…
cards.b: Deadline. 'Last time' comes with an actual date.
cards.ownerSaid: Deadline. 'Last time' comes with an actual date.

cards.prompt: In the main group chat, Jordan is the one who…
cards.a: Adds new people: "Everyone, this is Sam."
cards.b: Screenshots it all to two favorites.
cards.ownerSaid: Recruiter. "Everyone, this is Sam. Be nice."

cards.prompt: Months of small clashes with someone close, nobody at fault. Jordan would...
cards.a: Make a deal and give it time.
cards.b: Call it. Not a fit is reason enough.
cards.ownerSaid: Sat them down and made an actual deal.

cards.prompt: Jordan's family says 'absolutely not' to a plan. What does Jordan do?
cards.a: Sends a sibling or an aunt in first to soften them up.
cards.b: Says 'I'll think about it,' waits till they forget, does it.
cards.ownerSaid: Did it anyway. Told them after it went fine.

cards.prompt: Game night. A friend wins Uno with a stack that isn't in the official rules. Jordan...
cards.a: Pulls up the official rules and reads them out
cards.b: Lets it slide. They haven't won all night
cards.ownerSaid: Pull up the official rules. Read them out loud.

cards.prompt: Someone Jordan's age posts huge news: dream job, dream school. What would he do?
cards.a: Double-tap and forget it by the next video.
cards.ownerSaid: Opened my notes app and started a plan.

cards.prompt: Jordan moves in with someone. The sink is full and nobody moves. What does Jordan do?
cards.a: Runs it like home: nobody sits till the dishes are done.
cards.b: Splits chores by what each of them hates least.
cards.ownerSaid: Run it like home: nobody sits till the dishes are done.

level3.prompt: Which of these 12 are the real Jordan? Pick 5.

cards.name: Bends rules for good reasons
cards.heart: I look at the person, not the form.

cards.name: Relationship mechanic
cards.heart: I don't quit on people I chose.

cards.name: Compliment sandwich chef
cards.heart: I say it softly so you can actually hear it.

cards.name: Leaves you on read, still loves you
cards.heart: Missing you doesn't need a daily check-in.

cards.name: The honest review nobody asked for
cards.heart: I'd rather annoy you than lie to you.

cards.name: Keeps the receipts
cards.heart: I look after the person who got hurt first.

cards.name: Waiting for you to text first
cards.heart: Wanting to be thought of isn't embarrassing.

cards.name: Runs it by the family group chat
cards.heart: My family is part of my 'we', and I like it that way.

cards.name: Moves out, still calls on Sundays
cards.heart: Loving them and obeying them are two different things.

cards.name: Actually read the rulebook
cards.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.

cards.name: Same order, every time
cards.heart: I don't need new. I need mine.

stingPick.prompt: Which of these 4 lines would leave Jordan speechless for three seconds?

lines.t: You say it's just a job. You're quietly keeping score of every win.
To you, fair isn't paying the same. It's straining the same.
You forgive, technically. Your screenshots folder disagrees.
You think the truth is respect. Some people just feel poked.

pickTheRoast.prompt: Pick the roast Jordan would laugh at hardest.

lines.t: Sent me a payment request for $3.47. For fries. With a fries emoji.
Forgave everyone years ago. The screenshots folder did not.
Answers texts on a three-to-five business day schedule. Still my favorite.
Can't pick a new phone case without a family vote.
Says 'we're keeping it casual.' Already knows their coffee order by heart.
Asked for a quick opinion once. Got notes, bullet points and a follow-up.
